title: 5e-7: health snapshots + per-file history
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Extend the snapshot system to store per-file health scores for historical drill-down, plus per-component aggregates. Rewrite the trend tool to compute meaningful deltas.

- DB migration: health_snapshot_files(snapshot_id, file_id, score REAL, category_scores TEXT/JSON). Extend snapshots table with per-component health scores.
- Snapshot capture: compute per-file scores from current findings, aggregate to per-component, store both.
- Trend tool rewrite: diff two snapshots with per-file deltas (files that improved/degraded, by how much), per-component deltas, biomarker category breakdown.
- Historical query: "show me auth.rs health over the last N snapshots."

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] health_snapshot_files table storing per-file scores at each snapshot
- [ ] Per-component scores stored in snapshots (NLOC-weighted from file scores)
- [ ] Snapshot capture includes per-file and per-component health data
- [ ] Trend tool rewritten: per-file deltas (degraded/improved files), per-component deltas, category breakdown
- [ ] Per-file historical query API (file × snapshot range → score time series)
- [ ] Pattern family counts from 5e-6 included in snapshot data (if 5e-6 has landed)

## Blocked by

- sutra/85 (5e-2: health scoring)
- sutra/87 (5e-review-1: checkpoint 1 quality gate)"
